lead_with.text: Olivier told her the **US market analysis is ready**. Offer to walk through it: the strongest reason for her to show up.

lead_with.title: US biologicals market
lead_with.text: The US is one of the largest markets for biostimulants and biocontrol. Bioinput makers need strain identity and quality control for EPA/state registration: GoGenetic's genetic ID fits that (**to be confirmed** what she sells exactly).

lead_with.title: Brazil as a proof point
lead_with.text: Brazil's bioinputs segment grew about **30% over three harvests** (R$3.9B to R$5.1B, CropLife Brasil via Business Moment). Brazilian know-how is credible to US growers and biological companies.

lead_with.title: Small first step
lead_with.text: Propose a 3-month campaign to meet US biological product makers and labs: 10 qualified meetings a month.

person.text: Streak lists Michelle as **CEO** of GoGenetic (michelle@gogenetic.com.br). **No public profile was found** online. A 2025 article names **Vânia Pankievicz** as CEO of **GoGenetic Agro**; Michelle may lead the group or another unit (**to be confirmed** on the call; ask her role and scope gently). She wrote first in June 2026 (to oattia@gmail.com) and accepted invites in Portuguese ("Aceite").

company.text: The best public match is **GoGenetic Agro** (Business Moment, Apr 2025): it builds next-generation **bioinputs** using strain selection, **genomic analysis**, **qPCR quality control** and field validation by metagenomics. It sells **exclusive primers**, a genetic ID ("RG genético") that identifies the microorganisms in biological products, supports traceability, avoids cross-contamination and supports **MAPA registration** and strain exclusivity. Whether GoGenetic (gogenetic.com.br) is the same company, and its exact offer, is **to be confirmed**; the website could not be reached for this brief.

financials.text: No public financials found. Revenue, headcount and funding **to be confirmed**. Market context: global bioinputs about **US$13-15B** (2023); Brazil commercial segment **R$5.1B** in 2023/24 (CropLife Brasil via Business Moment).

industry.title: Biologicals are growing fast
industry.text: Farmers adopt biostimulants and biocontrol to cut chemicals; the US and Brazil are the two biggest arenas.

industry.title: Quality and identity matter
industry.text: Contamination and mislabeled strains are a known problem; regulators and buyers want proof of what is in the product.

industry.title: US registration
industry.text: Biopesticides go through the EPA; biostimulants have state-level rules. Testing partners help companies through that.

industry.title: Brazil leads on-farm biologicals
industry.text: Brazil is a world leader in bioinput use, which gives Brazilian firms credibility abroad.

talking_points: Can you tell me your role and which GoGenetic activities you lead?
Who are your customers today: bioinput manufacturers, labs, growers?
Why the US now: a customer, a partner, or a registration need?
Which US buyers would you want to meet first?
Do you already have US customers, distributors or a legal entity?
Who else decides on a US budget?
